rows.en: Celica: "What's that machine? I've never seen that model before..."
Ai: "If they're being attacked, we have to help!"
Celica: "Right. All right! Spirit Mechs, launch!"
Clovis: "Hey. Looks like you're having a hard time."
Aurelie: "Hmph! These guys are nothing.
Just stay out of my way."
Clovis: "Oh, how cold... I pushed myself to come all this way
for you, my love..."
Aurelie: "...Huh? R-Really...?"
Clovis: "Aurelie..."
Aurelie: "Uh... I, um..."
Clovis: "...Just kidding.
Well? Pretty smooth, wasn't I?"
Aurelie: "...Y-You..."
Clovis: "Hm? What's wrong?"
Aurelie: "..."
Clovis: "H-Hey! Are you trying to kill me?!"
Aurelie: "Hmph!"
Xiujian: "...You haven't changed."
Arthur: "Well, I doubt he'll ever change.
...It's been a while, Xiujian."
Xiujian: "Yes. You look well, too."
Touya: "Is this any time to stand around saying hello?!"
Aurelie: "...Is that him? Our promising new recruit?"
Touya: "Huh?"
Aurelie: "You piloted Zeifon right in your very first battle,
or so I hear. I'm expecting great things."
Xiujian: "...First, let's see what you can do."
Touya: "I don't feel all that welcome..."
Arthur: "Unlike a certain someone, they're serious about this.
They want to see your skills for themselves."
Clovis: "By 'a certain someone,' do you mean that cheerful,
charming fellow who's so popular with the ladies?"
Arthur: "Don't you mean 'a womanizer whose only redeeming feature
is his cheerfulness'?"
Clovis: "A man's finished once he loses interest in women, you know?
Well, show them what you're made of.
Right, Touya?"
Touya: "A-All right!"
Yamato: "Touya! I'm sure you know this already,
but even if a battle looks unwinnable, using 'Trust Commands'
can sometimes give you a way through!
Let's keep trying right to the end and show everyone
what you can do as a leader!"
Touya: "You got it!"
Fain: "All riiight! Here I go!"
Celica: "That idiot..."
Fain: "Ha ha ha ha! I'll give you a hand, everyone!
Heh heh heh... If you don't fear Fain Jin Barion,
come at me from any direction!!"
Ymir: "..."
Celica: "...*sigh*"
Ai: "H-Hey, wait! You're not getting away!"
Touya: "Ai, chasing them too far is dangerous!"
Arthur: "Touya's right.
Besides, your machine was just destroyed, wasn't it?
Let's repair it before the enemy returns."
Arthur: "Touya's right.
This won't be as easy as fighting our previous enemies."
Ai: "Tch. All right!"
Fain: "Raaaaah! Out of my way, out of my waaay!!"
Celica: "Don't tell me he's..."
Fain: "Hm! The Prana isn't flowing well...
I still need more fighting spirit... All right, next I'll do it all at once..."
Celica: "Idiot, idiot, idiot! Fain, you idiot!"
Fain: "Huh...?"
Celica: "Don't 'huh' me!
First you get into Dusseldorf without permission,
then you start piloting it recklessly...
I'm telling Rest!"
Fain: "N-No, that's..."
Celica: "Do you understand?!"
Fain: "Y-Yes... I understand..."
Celica: "Good. For now, help Touya and the others.
You can handle the piloting, right?"
Fain: "Yes... Huh? Then that means..."
Celica: "We're short on Pilots right now, and nobody can use Dusseldorf.
We need all the fighting strength we can get.
If you're serious about wanting to pilot it,
I'll ask my brother for you."
Fain: "R-Really?! Yahoo!!"
Celica: "Then I'll make an exception and let you this time.
...Now that that's settled, about its weapons..."
Fain: "I understand! With this Vial Jade
and Voltic Lancer, I'll show you how I'll wipe out the enemy!"
Celica: "You don't understand! Both of those can hit an area,
but neither has particularly long range.
There's no point in using them indiscriminately.
And as for Vial Jade, you can't use it
after moving. Keep that in mind. Also,
both weapons are especially effective when enemies
are next to one another... Are you listening?!"
Fain: "Yes, ma'am! There won't be any problems!
It's just what I'd expect from a Spirit Mech you've put such care into, Princess!"
Celica: "...*sigh* Well, fine.
Just don't do anything reckless. Got it?!
If you break Dusseldorf, you'll answer to me!"
Fain: "Leave it to me! I'll win this battle for you, Princess!!"
Celica: "...Honestly... Does he really understand...?"
Celica: "Faaaaaiiiin..."
Fain: "Ha, ha ha ha ha ha..."
Celica: "This isn't funny!
Do you realize what you've done?!"
Fain: "...I'm sorry..."
Celica: "Honestly! It's only just been finished!
What are you going to do if Dusseldorf breaks?!"
Fain: "But..."
Celica: "No buts! If you do anything like this again,
I'll cancel your Pilot registration!"
Fain: "Yes... Huh? Pilot registration?
...Then that means..."
Celica: "Well, there's nobody else who can use Dusseldorf right now,
and we need all the fighting strength we can get. If you're serious
about piloting it, I'll ask my brother for you."
Fain: "R-Really?! Yahoo!!"
Touya: "...Will he be all right?"
Celica: "Fain's Prana is getting stronger every day.
It's remarkable for an Agarthian.
He'll be fine. He'll learn to handle it beautifully."
Touya: "You really trust him."
Celica: "He is just a little too hotheaded, though."
Touya: "That's for sure."
Lodis: "...I'm glad you're all safe."
Ymir: "Yes. But Alforina..."
Tix: "Then it's true after all...?"
Ymir: "Unfortunately..."
Tix: "Damn........
Lodis... Surely you don't mean to let Zigrim get away
with this outrage? You can't!
We can't allow something like this!!
Lodis, we lead the continent! Let's send in the army!"
Celica: "Tix..."
Lodis: "Tix. I understand how you feel.
But if Agarthia acts now, Limberg will act, too.
Fram Zeo Isfandeil
would never let an opportunity like that slip by.
I can't let the continent be plunged into war..."
Tix: "B-But they might attack Agarthia
next, you know?!"
Lodis: "I, too, believe Zigrim's outrage is unforgivable.
But that doesn't mean we can stoop
to their level.
Besides, she wouldn't want that."
Tix: "How can you know that?!
I'm sure Queen Alforina is bitter about it, too! Why
did she have to die...? Why...? Damn!"
Celica: "Tix! Wait!"
Lodis: "Celica, it's best to leave him alone for now.
I'm sure Tix understands, too.
He's just confused."
Celica: "That might be true, but..."
Clovis: "He's right. You're being a little too protective.
I don't think treating the prince like that
is doing him any favors."
Celica: "Y-You think so? ...All right.
I'll leave him be for now."
Ai: "Lodis... The Kingdom of Agarthia knew Zigrim was invading,
but didn't tell anyone... Why?"
Lodis: "I'm sorry. If only I'd had the power to do more..."
Ai: "Apologizing to me won't help.
That's not what I'm asking.
I'm asking why you left them to die!"
Ymir: "Ai... There's no point in taking it out on His Highness.
Besides..."
Lodis: "No, Ai's right.
I underestimated the situation. Even though I didn't know,
I could have anticipated some of what would happen.
But I did no more than urge caution...
And it was negligence on my part not to know that Agarthia's government
had decided to stand by and watch..."
Ai: "...Tell me honestly what you yourself think, Lodis.
That's what I want to hear."
Lodis: "I'm here as an individual, rather than as the Kingdom of Agarthia's Crown Prince,
as a person named Lodis.
The kingdom's decisions don't bind me."
Ai: "...I see... I'm sorry I was so rude."
Lodis: "No. When I think of how you feel...
And I, too... No, let's leave it there.
In any case, getting ready must be our top priority now."
????: "Working yourselves too hard isn't wise, either."
Ymir: "Lady Ivel!"
Ivel: "It's been a while, Ymir.
I watched your battle.
It seems you've found some fine people to help you."
Touya: "Who's that old lady?"
Celica: "Hey! How can you say..."
Ivel: "No, no. The child is quite right.
Forgive my late introduction. Here in the Holy Land,
I serve as the person in charge.
My name is Ivel Eal Rochforn."
Touya: "Huh? Then that means..."
Celica: "She's the most important person here! Normally,
you wouldn't be able to meet her so easily!"
Touya: "Ha, ha ha ha..."
Celica: "Honestly..."
Ivel: "Now, now. It's quite all right.
What's the point in being angrier than the person he said it to?"
Celica: "Huh? Oh! I-I'm sorry..."
Ivel: "Besides, I'm not important in myself.
It's only the office of 'Matriarch' that carries authority.
Oh, that's right.
The Agarthian Council sent an inquiry
concerning you earlier."
Celica: "The Council...?
Lodis, do you know anything about it?"
Lodis: "No. Though I can more or less guess..."
Ivel: "...From now on, the Spirit Mechs would receive full backing
from Agarthia's government,
and independent operational authority, subject to its approval.
In return, all data obtained in battle and information about ≪Ze=Ode≫
would have to be reported.
That's the proposal."
Arthur: "In other words, we'd be operating under the Kingdom of Agarthia's
banner.
Nor does it guarantee our freedom of action.
They're essentially telling us to become part of the Kingdom of Agarthia
as one of its organizations."
Clovis: "Just the sort of thing those bigwigs would think up.
Who the hell do they think they are?"
Ivel: "I doubt they expect us to accept
those terms, either. Perhaps all they want is to be able to say
that we rejected their proposal."
Lodis: "That's probably right.
If that's their intention, then we should delay our answer
as long as possible."
Ivel: "Yes. I agree.
We'll handle that matter."
Lodis: "Yes."
Ivel: "Now, let's leave that discussion there.
It's about time we introduced your new crew.
Please come in."
???: "Excuse me."
Celica: "Oh, Bart! It's been a while!"
Bart: "It's been a while, Lady Celica.
I'll be serving as your purser.
I'm Bart Jin Gakkyok.
If there's anything you need, just let me know.
I'll get it for you, whatever it is."
Celica: "If you're here, Bart, does that mean she's here, too?"
Bart: "Yes. She only just arrived.
Of course, Prince Lodis doesn't know yet..."
Lodis: "D-Don't tell me..."
???: "Your... Highness...♥"
Lodis: "!! S-Sisk...
Lady Ivel! What's going on?!
Nobody told me about this!"
Sisk: "Hee hee. I wanted to surprise you, Your Highness,
so I asked them not to tell you.
Were you surprised?"
Lodis: "Surprised doesn't begin to cover it... You're not a warrior,
are you? Why..."
Sisk: "You don't have to be a warrior to be an observer.
Didn't you know?"
Lodis: "B-But..."
Sisk: "Won't you be coming aboard the Liebhofen, Your Highness?"
Lodis: "N-No. If I went aboard, it would cause problems
with other countries... Anyway, who hired Sisk...?"
Ymir: "I did. Was there a problem?"
Lodis: "A problem, you say..."
Ymir: "Sisk did very well on her aptitude test.
She also has a cook's license,
so we hired her as a cook, too.
Her situation with you is a personal matter, Your Highness."
Lodis: "W-Well, yes, that's true, but...
What am I going to do...? It can't be helped. Sisk, I'm counting on you."
Sisk: "I know. For you, Your Highness,
I'll give it my all!♥"
Touya: "Hey, Celica. What's the relationship between Sisk and Prince Lodis
anyway?"
Celica: "She's my brother's devoted fan."
Touya: "A fan...? What is he, a celebrity...?"
Celica: "She's actually a lady-in-waiting at the palace...
I never thought she'd go this far. My brother has his work cut out for him.
...Well, it's half his own fault."
Touya: "His own fault?"
Celica: "Right. He was the one who made the first move..."
Lodis: "Celica! What are you whispering about over there?!"
Celica: "Oh, no, nothing! ...Touya,
we shouldn't talk about this now. Anyway, that's the story."
Touya: "...I guess even a crown prince is only human."
Ivel: "And finally... Here's the Liebhofen's
captain, Admiral Roa Jin Krankheit.
He formerly commanded forces in York's army,
and has made a special exception to take this job."
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Touya: "..."
Captain Roa: "..."
Touya: "...Hey, is he in a bad mood or something?"
Ymir: "You think so?
He said he was pleased to meet you."
Touya: "Huh? All I heard was 'Hmm.'"
Ymir: "Oh, you must be joking..."
???: "Ymir, dearest!♥"
Ymir: "Ah! E-Emy?!"
Emy: "I missed you so much.
How could you be so cruel as to leave me behind?!"
Fain: "Y-Ymir...
S-So you're... into that...?"
Ymir: "W-Wait a moment..."
Emy: "That's right. The two of us share
an incredibly deep bond! Don't we, dearest?♥"
Fain: "Ooooooh! How could this haaaappen?!"
Touya: "Th-There's that sound again."
Ai: "Again...? Is that crystal making a sound?"
Touya: "Yeah. You still can't hear it?"
Ai: "No, not at all. Let me see it."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Ai: "...Wh-What's that?"
Ivel: "That's... a Resonance Crystal."
Ymir: "Lady Ivel..."
Ivel: "...It can't be..."
Ai: "Huh?! What? What is it?"
Ymir: "Th-That's..."
Emy: "No way... Rayode?!"
